entries.name: Nantes Hospital Veterinario
entries.duty: Open 24 hours in all services; no need to call ahead.
entries.note: InfoNegocios article (business press, not the clinic's own page): 'trabaja las 24 horas en todos sus servicios', quote 'abierto las 24 horas'. Address/phones from the same article; address and phone (021) 661-953 also in ABC 2020 list. Own site not found/opened; Instagram not openable (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED). Article (2022) announces a new building for 2025; address may have changed.

duty_i18n.pl: Czynne całą dobę we wszystkich usługach; nie trzeba dzwonić przed wizytą.
duty_i18n.cs: Otevřeno nonstop ve všech službách; není třeba volat předem.
duty_i18n.sv: Öppet dygnet runt för alla tjänster; du behöver inte ringa innan du kommer.
duty_i18n.da: Åbent 24 timer på alle afdelinger; du behøver ikke ringe på forhånd.
duty_i18n.fi: Auki 24 tuntia kaikissa palveluissa; ei tarvitse soittaa etukäteen.
duty_i18n.nb: Åpent hele døgnet for alle tjenester; du trenger ikke ringe på forhånd.
duty_i18n.sl: Vse storitve odprte 24 ur na dan; vnaprejšnji klic ni potreben.
duty_i18n.hr: Otvoreno 24 sata, sve usluge; nije potrebno zvati unaprijed.
duty_i18n.de: In allen Bereichen rund um die Uhr geöffnet; Anruf vorab nicht nötig.

duty_i18n.fi: Hoitoa tai päivystystä varten soita klinikalle.
duty_i18n.nb: Ring klinikken for behandling eller nødtilfeller.

duty_i18n.hr: Za skrb ili hitne slučajeve nazovi kliniku.
duty_i18n.de: Für Behandlung oder Notfälle bitte die Tierarztpraxis anrufen.

notes: Only 7 entries, 1 with 24 h (Nantes), from press articles - no clinic's own site could be opened. WebFetch only allows URLs surfaced by search; search engine returned almost no Paraguayan clinic sites. Blocked (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED): fcv.una.py, nantes.com.py guess, Nantes Instagram, gvetweb.com/asispetpy (Asispet: Luque + Lambaré, 24 h per article, needs phone/address). ip.gov.py article fetch errored. Not found: Colegio de Medicos Veterinarios del Paraguay site, SENACSA clinic list, duty rota, animal poison line. Nothing for Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, San Lorenzo, Villa Rica, Pedro Juan Caballero. ABC 2020 entries should be re-verified against own pages.
